<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}

  context={"endpoint"}

A message sent while the agent is mid-turn waits in a queue and is read when the turn ends (RN-673). While it waits, the person who SENT it can cancel it: the engine removes it from the queue and records `chat.message_cancelled`; it is never shown to the model. Someone else's message is 403.
